_about: Central threshold file read by the startup sentinel, the manual doctor, the debloat inventory and the maintenance runner's check to decide whether maintenance is due; the reminder reliability ledger reads only the review_conversation section. Every number in this file is the default the reference installation uses today; the key names are generic renames of the real keys. The loader reads only the keys it knows. Every other key, including the underscore-prefixed documentation keys and any misspelled key, is ignored; a misspelled key shows up only as a missing key filled from defaults (threshold_source file+defaults). An unreadable file falls back to the defaults and records the error. Skills and reminder contracts never copy these numbers; the code that needs them reads this file.

debloat._notes: Size and accumulation signals for a debloat review (see SYSTEM_HEALTH_AND_GOVERNANCE.md, section 11). Every startup reminder from this section waits until maintenance_min_interval_days have passed since a verified maintenance receipt; growth or urgency cannot bypass that cooldown. The manual doctor still lists due items during the cooldown. The two instruction-file limits use different units because the two agents' files are measured differently. The startup sentinel also compares backup_count with the doctor's count of backup-named files, a different measure from the inventory's count of files inside the two backup folders.

skill_crystallization._notes: Backlog of human-gated candidates mined from repeated runbooks. Due when failures reach runbook_failure; or when total reaches runbook_total and the oldest pending candidate is at least runbook_pending_age_days old; or when the miner's queue is older than runbook_rerun_age_days while the event stream keeps growing (rerun the miner).

skill_discovery._notes: Pattern review is due review_interval_days after the last completed review, and only if at least one semantic memory note changed since that review's watermark; or when screen_digest_days new validated daily digests exist. An open, unreviewed batch is due immediately.

skill_queue._notes: Shared skill-opportunity queue. One approved-for-validation candidate is enough to remind (highest priority); otherwise remind when proposed plus needs-human-review candidates reach the second value.

memory_graph._notes: Memory-graph refresh is due when unconsumed pending entries reach pending_count, or when more memory cards differ from the active release than unconsumed entries can explain; that comparison is a count and cannot prove that every change was queued, and it lives in the probe code, not in this file. Graph age is reported but does not trigger a reminder. Below the threshold does not mean every new memory is in the graph.

review_conversation._notes: Optional owner review conversation prepared from local evidence. After a visible reminder, wait reminder_interval_days before reminding again; remind at most once per prepared batch; flag the material for a relevance recheck when it is older than material_recheck_after_days.

knowledge_vault_graph._notes: Research knowledge vault graph. Due when the pending count reaches pending_count: the full health check in generation mode uses the effective count (non-comment entries minus those the active generation adopted at their current source version); the session-start probe, and every check in single-snapshot mode, use the raw non-comment count. Age is informational. Unlike the memory graph, it has no count comparison of changed sources against the queue.
